newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MANILA SHARE INDEX FALLS TO 20-MONTH LOW.
newsitem.headline: MANILA SHARE INDEX FALLS TO 20-MONTH LOW.

text.p: Philippine shares tumbled further on Thursday, closing at a 20-month low as news of an interest rate cut was offset by the persisting currency turmoil in the region, traders said.
The composite index gave up 33.59 points, or 1.33 percent, to end at 2,493.49. It was the lowest close since December 1995.

"The recent peso volatility is still there, nullifying whatever positive sentiment there is that have been brought about by a decline in interest rates," said Jun Trinidad, research head at DBS Securities.
